P15u: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when things are required as pre-reqs for people to get medicine, it can put a lot of power in the hands of the gatekeepers, right when people are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that people disclose whatever the group wants them to.
